scripts.desktop:build: pnpm --filter @c4ml/editor... run build && pnpm --filter @c4ml/desktop... run build
scripts.desktop:make: pnpm run desktop:build && pnpm --filter @c4ml/desktop run make
scripts.desktop:package: pnpm run desktop:build && pnpm --filter @c4ml/desktop run package
scripts.desktop:smoke: pnpm run desktop:package && pnpm --filter @c4ml/desktop run smoke
scripts.desktop:start: pnpm run desktop:package && pnpm --filter @c4ml/desktop run start
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build && pnpm run typecheck:tests
scripts.check: pnpm run build && pnpm run check:editor-production && pnpm run check:desktop-production && pnpm run check:worker-bundles && pnpm run typecheck:tests && pnpm run test
